report:
Reassessed the complete claim and all evidence. Requirements are stash-local content addressing for every scalar/slice allocation, canonical handles for equal typed content, and actual comparison on hash collisions. The ordinary implementation association includes lib.rs: Stash owns its own intern map; alloc keys by StaticSelf TypeId/content hash/collision ordinal, compares typed values, and reuses only equal entries. alloc_slice hashes length/elements and compares the complete typed slice; iterator allocation and append delegate to it. Nested handles hash their stored structural hashes. The new count guard skips entries with zero or multiple elements before scalar reads, resolving scalar/slice bucket collisions without misinterpreting their shape.
All ordinary tests reviewed: hash_cons_compound_type asserts repeated derived Pair values with nested Point pointers share a handle; hash_cons_slice_dedup asserts equal derived Point slices share; hash_cons_collision_stores_both forces equal hashes and asserts different values have different handles, repeats reuse, and both contents remain readable. Captured Point declaration supports these tests. New empty_unit_slice_and_scalar_do_not_confuse_interning asserts empty-slice and unit-scalar content plus independent repeat canonicalization. The service_spec TODO explicitly defers associating/reviewing the broader scalar, nested-pointer, slice, duplicate, forced-collision, and derived/handwritten parity matrix; completion requires that substantive evidence and review, especially broader slice collisions. It is accepted as deferred test adequacy, not proof of complete coverage; it did not excuse the reproduced implementation panic.
Baseline: personally verified all three original source files exactly matched historical snapshots before investigation. Final lib.rs differs only by the reviewed count guard and accurate SAFETY comment describing typed key, singleton count, and aligned initialized storage; arena_tests adds the regression. Fresh start captured changed evidence and all current associations; other historical reasoning was reassessed rather than copied as approval.
Execution: personally ran cargo fmt and cargo build successfully (build emitted existing warnings). Before the fix, cargo test -p sage-stash --test arena_tests empty_unit_slice_and_scalar_do_not_confuse_interning -- --exact tests::empty_unit_slice_and_scalar_do_not_confuse_interning ran one test and failed at lib.rs:884 with count assertion left 0/right 1 during scalar allocation after an empty unit slice. After coordinator applied the guard, cargo test -p sage-stash --test arena_tests tests::empty_unit_slice_and_scalar_do_not_confuse_interning -- --exact passed one test. No broad functional suite was personally run; coordinator's separately reported suite/build is not personal execution evidence. No remaining edits requested for this anchor; explicit broader test TODO remains visible.
